ai_summary: Bosch Limited has announced a recommended final dividend of Rs. 270 per share for FY 2025-26, which will be subject to Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) as per the Income-tax Act, 2025. Shareholders must submit specific tax-related documents by July 27, 2026, to ensure the appropriate withholding tax rate is applied; otherwise, a higher default rate will be deducted, leaving shareholders responsible for claiming any eligible refunds from tax authorities. The company will not be liable for higher deductions due to non-compliance with documentation requirements.
